name.value: Lin Chinese Cuisine And Tea House

description.value: Lin Chinese Cuisine is an award-winning Shanghainese restaurant on West Broadway in Vancouver, known for dishes like Xiao Long Bao (Shanghai juicy pork dumplings), Tea Smoked Duck, and Honey Prawns. The restaurant offers both dine-in and online ordering, and a gluten-free menu is available on request. A touring cyclist heading along the Broadway corridor would find a full sit-down meal experience with a wide range of classic and regional Chinese dishes.
